claims.claim: The item is a high quality solar panel.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a large black metal mesh/grille panel, not a solar panel surface.
Witness photos show a metal mesh panel with a grid pattern; no inverter body or controls are visible.

claims.claim: The item is a lithium or tubular battery.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a standing metal mesh/grille sheet; no battery casing/terminals are visible.
No battery is shown in the witness photos; only a metal mesh panel is visible.

claims.claim: The battery holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: No battery or test/measurement is shown in the witness photos.
No battery identity or repair/test evidence is visible in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: seller is advertising solar/inverter/batteries, but the witness photos show a metal mesh/grille panel.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact item being sold with a label/serial (if any) and a close-up showing whether it is a battery/inverter/solar panel or a grille sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used metal mesh/grille panel only (no solar/battery value).

risks.risk: Unknown dimensions and thickness affect scrap/utility value.
risks.proof: Provide a tape-measure photo showing height, width, and thickness (or gauge) at multiple points.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely size/thickness bracket for a grille sheet.

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible rust, dents, bent frame, loose welds/fasteners not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of edges/corners and any weld lines/fastener points, plus a rust/corrosion photo in bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/unknown condition (discounted for potential repairs).

risks.risk: Material type risk (steel vs aluminum) affects durability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of a magnet test result (magnet sticks vs not) and/or a close-up showing material markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as steel (or worst-case for corrosion) until confirmed.

risks.risk: If it is meant to be part of a door/window/partition, missing frame/hinges/locks could reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photos showing whether it includes a frame, hinges, locks, or mounting hardware (full perimeter view).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standalone grille sheet without hardware.

proof_requests: Send photos of the exact item for sale (full front, full back, and close-ups of edges/corners) to confirm it is a metal mesh/grille panel and not a solar panel/inverter/battery.
Provide exact dimensions (height, width) and thickness/gauge with a tape measure in-frame.
Show material confirmation (magnet test photo) and any rust/corrosion close-ups.
Show whether it has any frame/hinges/locks/mounting hardware (if applicable) with perimeter shots.
response.reason: The witness photos consistently show a metal mesh/grille panel, so it can be priced as that worst-case category; the seller’s battery/solar/inverter claims are not supported by the photos.
